title: Customer Resolution Satisfaction Survey – Privacy Collection Notice
summary: This page provides a privacy collection notice for the Customer Resolution Satisfaction Survey, explaining how Service NSW collects and uses your personal information.

faqs.q: Why is Service NSW collecting my information?
faqs.a: The information is collected to improve how Service NSW responds to and handles feedback, and to communicate with you about your feedback or interactions with Service NSW.

faqs.q: How will my personal information be used?
faqs.a: Your information will be used to continually improve customer support and feedback management, to communicate about your interactions, and for reporting, research, and statistical purposes.

faqs.q: What if I have privacy concerns?
faqs.a: You can make privacy enquiries or complaints, and you can access and seek correction of the information we handle.
